hook: Light is the fastest thing but also a particle
fact: Light travels 300,000 km/s as waves yet behaves as packets (photons) — it's both simultaneously. Quantum mechanics: mind = blown.
subject: physics

hook: Your phone's GPS relies on Einstein's time dilation
fact: Satellites orbit faster, so their time runs ~38 microseconds/day slower. Without Einstein's relativity correction, GPS fails in weeks.
subject: physics

hook: Black holes warp spacetime so severely light can't escape
fact: At the event horizon, gravity's pull exceeds light's speed — even photons get trapped. Spacetime itself bends into a one-way trap.
subject: physics

hook: Electrons exist in ALL possible positions until you look
fact: Quantum superposition means electrons are everywhere at once—probability clouds. Measuring collapses them to ONE spot.
subject: physics

hook: Sound travels differently in water than air (4x faster)
fact: Water molecules are packed tightly; vibrations transfer quickly. In air, molecules are sparse — sound creeps at 343 m/s.
subject: physics

hook: Gravity doesn't work like you think (it's geometry)
fact: Gravity isn't a force pulling you down — it's spacetime curvature. Earth warps space around it; you're falling through geometry.
subject: physics

hook: Your body is 99.9% empty space (atoms are mostly void)
fact: Electrons orbit nuclei far apart; if atoms were compacted, 7 billion humans would fit in a sugar cube.
subject: physics

hook: A neutron star's teaspoon weighs as much as a mountain
fact: Neutron stars pack stellar mass into city-sized spheres. One teaspoon = 6 billion tons. A thimble = all humans combined.
subject: physics

hook: Heat moves via three invisible methods (conduction, convection, radiation)
fact: Touching a hot cup = conduction. Steam rising = convection. Feeling sun's warmth = radiation. Three totally different mechanisms.
subject: physics

hook: Friction is just electromagnetic repulsion at the microscopic level
fact: Surfaces aren't smooth — they're jagged. Electrons repel as peaks collide, creating the drag we call 'friction.'
subject: physics

hook: The universe is expanding & accelerating (dark energy powers it)
fact: Galaxies rush away from each other faster & faster. Invisible dark energy = 68% of the universe's content. We don't know what it is.
subject: physics

hook: Time isn't absolute — it slows near massive objects
fact: Clocks tick slower on a mountain than in a valley. GPS satellites age slower than Earth clocks due to relativity.
subject: physics

hook: Quantum entanglement: measuring one particle affects another instantly
fact: Twin particles share a quantum state — change one, the other 'knows' immediately across any distance. Einstein called it 'spooky.'
subject: physics

hook: A rainbow is a 42-degree cone of light inside your eye
fact: Sunlight refracts, reflects, & refracts again inside water droplets at exactly 42° — why rainbows always appear at that angle.
subject: physics

hook: Magnets have no monopoles — you can't have just a North pole
fact: Break a magnet in half, you get two dipoles. Not one North & one South — always pairs. It's a quantum symmetry.
subject: physics

hook: Your weight changes depending on where you stand on Earth
fact: At the equator, centrifugal force reduces weight by 0.3%. Mountains & valleys also shift gravity. You're lighter at high altitude.
subject: physics

hook: Antimatter exists and annihilates matter in a blinding flash
fact: Positrons (anti-electrons) annihilate electrons, releasing energy as E=mc². Medical PET scans use this principle to image bodies.
subject: physics

hook: Sound can be focused to burn through steel (ultrasound)
fact: High-frequency sound waves concentrated into a beam generate enough energy to cut tissue. Used in medical & industrial applications.
subject: physics

hook: Photosynthesis relies on quantum tunneling in chlorophyll
fact: Electrons 'tunnel' through energy barriers that classical physics says is impossible. Plants harness quantum mechanics for light capture.
subject: physics

hook: A spinning top defies gravity through gyroscopic precession
fact: Angular momentum creates an invisible 'force' that keeps it upright. Gravity pulls down, but spin keeps it balanced.
subject: physics

hook: Light slows down inside glass (it's not faster in water)
fact: Light moves ~2/3 its vacuum speed in water. This bending (refraction) is why straws look bent in glasses.
subject: physics

hook: Superfluid helium flows without friction at ultra-cold temps
fact: Below 2.17 Kelvin, helium becomes a 'superfluid' — it climbs walls & flows through solid walls. Quantum mechanics unleashed.
subject: physics

hook: The observer effect: observing a particle changes its behavior
fact: In quantum mechanics, measuring an electron's position changes its momentum. The act of observation collapses superposition.
subject: physics

hook: Pressure increases as you go deeper — water crushes differently
fact: Every 10 meters deep adds 1 atm of pressure. At 11,000 m depth, pressure reaches 1,100 atm — equivalent to 50 jumbo jets stacked on you.
subject: physics

hook: Thunder is a shockwave; lightning is plasma at 30,000 Kelvin
fact: Lightning's temperature exceeds the sun's surface. The rapid expansion creates a shockwave we hear as thunder — thunder always follows.
subject: physics

hook: Turbulence follows the Navier-Stokes equations (one of math's greatest unsolved problems)
fact: We can describe turbulence mathematically, but proving it's always 'smooth' is unsolved. A $1 million prize awaits the proof.
subject: physics

hook: Refraction makes underwater objects appear closer than they are
fact: Light bends at water's surface, making a fish at 1 meter look 0.75 meters away. This is why spear fishing requires aiming lower.
subject: physics

hook: Perpetual motion machines violate entropy — physics forbids them
fact: The second law of thermodynamics: disorder always increases. Energy always dissipates. No machine can run forever without input.
subject: physics

hook: Lasers emit coherent light; all photons march in lockstep
fact: Regular light is random. Lasers amplify one wave — all photons have the same phase, frequency, & direction. Pure coherence.
subject: physics

hook: Your heartbeat creates shock waves in your arteries (pulse)
fact: Blood ejected from the heart travels at ~1 m/s as a pressure wave. You can feel this wave at your wrist — that's your pulse.
